description:
3M has a long\-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.**Job Description:**

**Location:** Coimbatore  

**Territory:** Coimbatore, Trichy, Madurai, Tuticorin \& Kerala  

**Reports to:** Regional Sales Manager – South

**Job Summary**  

Responsible for achieving secondary sales targets across key accounts, driving penetration of the core and priority portfolio, developing new applications/business, and acquiring new profitable accounts across targeted industrial segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Achieve sales targets across assigned key accounts and territory.
* Acquire and develop new accounts in **Metal Fabrication, Auto Components, Casting \& Forging, and Aerospace**.
* Drive product demonstrations, application development, replication, and market share growth.
* Build relationships with **Key Opinion Leaders and senior stakeholders** within key accounts.
* Execute technical, marketing, sales promotion, and product demonstration activities.
* Maintain regular customer engagement and achieve defined call\-rate targets through **Salesforce CRM**.
* Drive sales of new products and core portfolio products.
* Maintain a healthy opportunity pipeline and ensure effective opportunity management through Salesforce.
* Demonstrate product value propositions using sales\-aid tools.
* Collaborate with **Channel Partners, Channel Team, Application Engineering, and Marketing** teams to achieve territory objectives.
* Conduct periodic joint reviews with channel partners and DSRs to ensure alignment, sales growth, and service levels.

### **Qualification**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Engineering** (Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Metallurgy or related discipline) preferred.
* **MBA/PGDM in Sales \& Marketing** is an added advantage.
* Typically **3–5 years of experience** in B2B/industrial sales, key account management, or technical sales.
* Experience in **abrasives, welding, cutting tools, industrial lubricants, paints, power tools, or related industrial products** will be preferred.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
**Job Description:**  
We are looking for a dynamic and results\-driven **Business Development Executive** to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, and contributing to company growth through strategic sales and marketing efforts.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify and generate new business leads and opportunities
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and partners
* Conduct market research and analyze industry trends
* Present company services to potential clients and close deals
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure client satisfaction
* Prepare sales reports and business development plans

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field
* Good communication and negotiation skills
* Strong interpersonal and relationship management abilities
* Basic knowledge of sales, marketing, and client handling
* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented mindset
* Freshers and experienced candidates can apply

**Benefits:**  
✔ Attractive salary with performance incentives  
✔ Career growth opportunities  
✔ Hands\-on experience in business development  
✔ Friendly and professional work environment  
✔ Opportunity for long\-term career growth

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher, Internship

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
